spec.title: kasha
spec.description: Box health and traffic from kasha's /metrics endpoint, for one or more boxes of a scrape job.

spec.title: Boxes down
spec.description: Selected boxes Prometheus failed to scrape on its last attempt (up == 0). A box no service discovery lists any more drops out instead of counting as down. Every other panel goes blank for a box that is down.

spec.title: Objects
spec.description: Narinfos in the index, summed over the selected boxes.

spec.title: Hit ratio
spec.description: Share of narinfo lookups the selected boxes answered themselves over the time range. A narinfo answered by pull-through counts as a hit.

spec.title: Served
spec.description: NAR bytes the selected boxes sent to clients over the time range.

spec.title: Sync age
spec.description: Age of the stalest flake's last mirror-down, worst box. Healthy stays under KASHA_SYNC_INTERVAL plus the cycle's run time; red past 1h matches the KashaSyncStale alert. Needs KASHA_REMOTE.

spec.title: To mirror up
spec.description: Local-origin generations not yet mirrored to the remote cache, worst box. Brief nonzero values follow a push; one that stays up means mirror-up is stuck (KashaMirrorUpStuck fires after 1h).

spec.title: GC sweep age
spec.description: Age of the last box GC sweep attempt, worst box. Red past 2 days matches the KashaSweepStale alert. Absent until a box's first sweep; needs KASHA_REMOTE.

spec.title: Pull failures
spec.description: Pull-through lookups a source could not answer plus background fetches that failed, over the time range. The logs say why (narinfo lookup failed, pull-through fetch failed); the Pull-through tab shows the ratio the KashaPullThroughFailing alert watches.

spec.title: Turned away
spec.description: Narinfo and NAR requests pull-through sent away over the time range: busy (too many already wait, raise KASHA_MAX_INFLIGHT) or capped (over KASHA_PULL_THROUGH_MAX_PENDING). Red matches the KashaPullThroughBusy alert.

spec.title: Pull queue
spec.description: Pull-through downloads not started yet, worst box. A queue that does not drain for 30 minutes fires KashaPullThroughBacklog: raise KASHA_PULL_THROUGH_WORKERS or look for a slow source.

spec.title: Cap used
spec.description: Unlisted bytes against KASHA_UNLISTED_MAX_BYTES after the last eviction pass, worst box. Above 100 % only paths used in the last 10 minutes are left: raise the cap. Red matches the KashaUnlistedOverCap alert.

spec.title: Not zstd
spec.description: NAR bytes on disk whose file is not zstd (xz, bzip2, none, other), summed over the selected boxes. With KASHA_REENCODE on this falls as the re-encoder works and orphan removal takes the old files, a day or more later. Refreshed at most every 5 minutes.

spec.title: Narinfo requests
spec.description: Narinfo GET/HEAD requests per interval by result, summed over the selected boxes. hit: the box had it (or pull-through found it). miss: answered 404, the client falls back to its next substituter.

spec.title: Narinfo hit ratio
spec.description: Share of narinfo lookups the box answered, over the preceding hour. Falls when clients ask for paths the box neither holds nor can pull through.

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(kasha_narinfo_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", result="hit"}[1h])) / sum by (instance) (rate(kasha_narinfo_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}[1h]))

spec.title: NAR bytes by route
spec.description: NAR bytes moved per interval, summed over the selected boxes. served: sent to clients. ingest: pushed in. down/pull: fetched by mirror-down or pull-through, by source (pull counts bytes as the source sent them). up: mirrored to the remote cache. Counted when a transfer completes, so one large NAR shows as one tall bar.

spec.title: NAR bytes by route in range
spec.description: Total NAR bytes per route over the time range, summed over the selected boxes. The served/fetched balance says how much the box saves its clients' uplinks.

spec.title: Pushes
spec.description: PUT requests per interval by result. accepted: stored. rejected: bad content or a signature from no KASHA_TRUSTED_KEYS key (rejected ingest in the logs). unauthorized: no valid KASHA_TOKEN.

spec.title: Served per box
spec.description: NAR bytes each box sent to clients per interval. Narinfos are left out: they are noise next to NARs.

spec.title: Pull-through lookups
spec.description: Narinfo misses handled by pull-through per interval, summed over the selected boxes. found: a source had it. miss: no source had it. negative: a remembered miss. failed: a source could not answer. capped, busy: sent away.

spec.title: Pull-through failure ratio
spec.description: Share of lookups that asked a source and failed, and of background fetches that failed, over 30 minutes. Dashed line at 10 %: the KashaPullThroughFailing threshold (the alert also wants at least 10 failures).

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(kasha_pull_through_lookups_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", result="failed"}[30m])) / sum by (instance) (rate(kasha_pull_through_lookups_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", result!="negative"}[30m]))

sum by (instance) (rate(kasha_pull_through_fetches_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", result="failed"}[30m])) / sum by (instance) (rate(kasha_pull_through_fetches_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}[30m]))

spec.title: Background fetches
spec.description: Background NAR fetches ended per interval, summed over the selected boxes. stored: the NAR is on disk as zstd. failed: see pull-through fetch failed in the logs. abandoned: a push or mirror-down stored the path first.

spec.title: Pending and queued
spec.description: pending: narinfos answered whose NAR is not stored yet. queued: of those, downloads not started. Queued that never drains means downloads cannot keep up: raise KASHA_PULL_THROUGH_WORKERS (KashaPullThroughBacklog).

spec.title: NAR requests joining a download
spec.description: NAR requests per interval for a path whose download is in flight. waited: held until it ended. busy: sent away with 404 because a quarter of KASHA_MAX_INFLIGHT requests already wait.

spec.title: Pulled bytes by source
spec.description: Bytes pull-through fetched per interval, as the source sent them (before re-encoding to zstd). remote: the remote cache. upstream: KASHA_UPSTREAMS.

spec.title: Time since last sync, per flake
spec.description: Age of the end of the last mirror-down cycle that covered the flake. A healthy box resets it every KASHA_SYNC_INTERVAL. Dashed line at 1h: the KashaSyncStale threshold; past it, look for mirror-down failed in the logs.

spec.expr: time() - max by (instance, flake) (kasha_flake_last_sync_timestamp_seconds{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", flake=~"$flake"})

spec.title: Gaps, per flake
spec.description: Closure paths in the flake's box-retained manifests that no source could supply. Usually expected: a manifest can list paths neither the remote cache nor an upstream holds. A gap is retried at most once an hour and is never an error.

spec.title: Time since a generation was published, per branch
spec.description: Age of the newest manifest's timestamp: when CI or a local push last produced something for the branch. Unlike last sync, this resets only when there is new data, so a steady climb means the producer is quiet, not the box.

spec.expr: time() - max by (instance, flake, branch) (kasha_generation_published_timestamp_seconds{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", flake=~"$flake"})

spec.title: Time since the box received a generation, per branch
spec.description: Age of the newest manifest file on the box: when mirror-down or a push last brought a new generation. Survives restarts. Compare with the published age: a gap between them is replication lag.

spec.expr: time() - max by (instance, flake, branch) (kasha_generation_arrived_timestamp_seconds{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", flake=~"$flake"})

spec.title: Newest generation per branch
spec.description: Since published: age of the manifest timestamp. Since arrived: age of the box's copy. Replication lag: arrival minus publish, i.e. how long the generation took to reach the box (negative when the box's clock is behind the producer's).

spec.expr: time() - max by (instance, flake, branch) (kasha_generation_published_timestamp_seconds{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", flake=~"$flake"})
time() - max by (instance, flake, branch) (kasha_generation_arrived_timestamp_seconds{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", flake=~"$flake"})

max by (instance, flake, branch) (kasha_generation_arrived_timestamp_seconds{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", flake=~"$flake"}) - max by (instance, flake, branch) (kasha_generation_published_timestamp_seconds{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", flake=~"$flake"})

spec.title: Mirror-up pending
spec.description: Local-origin generations not yet mirrored up. One that stays above zero means a push is incomplete on the box or the remote write failed: look for mirror-up deferred in the logs (KashaMirrorUpStuck fires after 1h).

spec.title: Mirror bytes
spec.description: NAR bytes mirror-down fetched (by source: remote cache or KASHA_UPSTREAMS) and mirror-up sent, per interval. Counted when a transfer completes.

spec.expr: sum by (instance, direction, source) (increase(kasha_nar_bytes_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", direction=~"down|up"}[$__interval])) > 0

spec.title: Objects
spec.description: Narinfos in each box's index. Rises with pushes, mirror-down and pull-through; falls with box GC and eviction.

spec.title: NAR bytes on disk by encoding
spec.description: Disk used by NAR files, summed over the selected boxes and stacked by the encoding their file name says, so the top line is the NAR total. Old files no narinfo names count until orphan removal takes them. Refreshed at most every 5 minutes. store_bytes in /status has the whole store.

spec.title: NAR age
spec.description: Oldest NAR on disk, and median and 90th percentile age estimated from the buckets (coarse: interpolated within a bucket). Age counts from when the box stored the NAR or a narinfo last named it, and under a cap from its last read.

spec.title: NARs by age
spec.description: NAR count per age bucket, summed over the selected boxes (a bucket holds NARs younger than its label and older than the previous one). Refreshed at most every 5 minutes.

spec.title: NAR bytes by age
spec.description: Disk used per age bucket, summed over the selected boxes (a bucket holds NARs younger than its label and older than the previous one). Refreshed at most every 5 minutes.

spec.title: NARs stored by route and encoding
spec.description: NAR files stored per second, summed over the selected boxes, by how they arrived (ingest: pushed, down: mirror-down, pull: pull-through) and the encoding they arrived in: which route brings xz in. Pull-through stores every one as zstd whatever it arrived in.

spec.title: Re-encoded paths
spec.description: Paths the re-encoder took on per interval, summed over the selected boxes. reencoded: stored as zstd and the narinfo swapped. failed: the NAR failed its check or cannot be decoded, served as it is and not tried again until restart (logs: cannot re-encode). lost: the narinfo changed meanwhile, tried later. error: a store error, tried again.

spec.title: Re-encoded bytes
spec.description: Bytes of NAR files the re-encoder replaced per interval, summed over the selected boxes. old: the file as stored before. new: the zstd file the narinfo names now. The old file stays on disk until orphan removal takes it.

spec.title: Size change from re-encoding
spec.description: zstd file sizes minus the sizes of the files they replaced, over the time range, summed over the selected boxes. Usually positive: xz packs tighter than zstd at level 3, and the box trades that disk for faster decoding on its clients (ADR-0015). Until orphan removal takes the old files, both copies take disk.

spec.title: zstd size vs old
spec.description: Size of the zstd files the re-encoder wrote as a share of the files they replaced, over the time range. Above 100 % is expected for xz, which packs tighter than zstd at level 3; below it for uncompressed NARs.

spec.title: Re-encode failures
spec.description: Paths the re-encoder could not convert over the time range (failed plus error). failed paths are most likely pushed NARs that do not match their narinfo; the logs name each.

spec.title: Last box GC sweep
spec.description: Age of the last box GC sweep attempt, per box. Red past 2 days matches the KashaSweepStale alert; box sweep failed in the logs says why. Absent until the first sweep.

spec.title: Box GC deletions
spec.description: Narinfos and NARs box GC sweeps deleted per interval: expired generations' paths and orphans no narinfo names.

spec.title: Unlisted bytes and cap
spec.description: Bytes of unlisted paths (no retained manifest lists them) after each eviction pass, and the cap. A pass evicts down to 90 % of the cap; above the cap, paths used in the last 10 minutes alone exceed it.

spec.title: Unlisted paths
spec.description: Paths no retained manifest lists, after each eviction pass: what the cap holds.

spec.title: Evictions
spec.description: Unlisted paths evicted per interval. A steady rate is the cap working; a steep one, with the same paths pulled through again, means the cap is smaller than the clients' working set.

spec.title: Evicted vs pulled bytes
spec.description: Bytes eviction removed against bytes pull-through fetched, per interval. Close values mean the box re-fetches what it evicts: raise KASHA_UNLISTED_MAX_BYTES.

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (increase(kasha_nar_bytes_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", direction="pull"}[$__interval])) and on (instance) max by (instance) (kasha_unlisted_max_bytes{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"})

spec.title: Version
spec.description: kasha version the selected boxes run, with how many run it. Several values mean a rollout is under way or stuck. Absent before 0.16.0, which added kasha_build_info.

spec.title: NAR disk
spec.description: Disk used by NAR files, summed over the selected boxes: the total of NAR bytes by age. Narinfos and manifests are left out; /status has the whole store as store_bytes. Refreshed at most every 5 minutes.

spec.title: Disk free
spec.description: Share of the store's filesystem the box can still write, worst box. Red below 10 % matches the KashaStoreFilesystemLow alert: raise the filesystem or lower KASHA_UNLISTED_MAX_BYTES.

spec.expr: min(max by (instance) (kasha_store_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (instance) (kasha_store_filesystem_size_bytes{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

spec.title: Slots used
spec.description: Peak share of the KASHA_MAX_INFLIGHT request slots in use at any scrape over the time range, worst box. Near 100 % new requests wait for a slot; pull-through turns some away (busy) well before.

spec.expr: max(max by (instance) (max_over_time(kasha_http_inflight_requests{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / max by (instance) (kasha_http_max_inflight_requests{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

spec.title: Narinfo p90
spec.description: 90th percentile time to answer a narinfo GET over the time range, all selected boxes. From the index it is milliseconds; a pull-through lookup adds the sources' answer time (Pull-through tab).

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le) (increase(kasha_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", method="GET", route="narinfo"}[$__range])))

spec.title: Server errors
spec.description: 5xx responses over the time range, summed over the selected boxes: a store file the box could not open (open failed in the logs).

spec.title: Responses by route and code
spec.description: Responses per interval by route and status code, summed over the selected boxes; /metrics and /status are left out. narinfo 404: a miss, the client falls back to its next substituter. nar 404: a NAR the box lacks, or one pull-through turned away (busy). 401 and 400: refused pushes. 5xx: the logs say why.

spec.title: NAR requests
spec.description: NAR requests per interval by method and status code, summed over the selected boxes. Next to Narinfo requests: a client that finds a narinfo then asks for its NAR, so a NAR 404 after a narinfo hit means the box answered for a NAR it cannot serve.

spec.title: Request duration
spec.description: Median and 90th percentile time from taking a GET on to its response written, all selected boxes. narinfo: index lookups plus pull-through waits. nar: mostly the transfer, so it grows with NAR size and the client's bandwidth. Waiting for a request slot is not included (Request slots).

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(kasha_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", method="GET", route="narinfo"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le) (rate(kasha_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", method="GET", route="narinfo"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(kasha_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", method="GET", route="nar"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le) (rate(kasha_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", method="GET", route="nar"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Request slots
spec.description: Requests holding one of the KASHA_MAX_INFLIGHT slots per box at each scrape, and the cap. A request holds its slot for the whole transfer, so slow clients fill slots too. At the cap new requests wait; pull-through turns narinfo and NAR waiters away at a quarter of it.

spec.title: Source lookup duration
spec.description: Median and 90th percentile time a source took to answer a narinfo lookup, found or not, by source (remote: the remote cache, else the upstream's host). Sources are asked in order, so a client's narinfo waits for the sum of the sources asked before one has the path. Timeouts count at KASHA_PULL_THROUGH_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT.

spec.title: Store filesystem free
spec.description: Share of the filesystem holding the store root the box can still write, per box. Other data on the same filesystem counts too. Dashed line at 10 %: the KashaStoreFilesystemLow threshold.

spec.expr: max by (instance) (kasha_store_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (instance) (kasha_store_filesystem_size_bytes{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"})

spec.title: NAR bytes per box
spec.description: Disk used by NAR files on each box, from the age scan (refreshed at most every 5 minutes). Old files no narinfo names count until orphan removal takes them.
